# Graffiti Generator

Graffiti generator: turn a word or a name into graffiti art in wildstyle, bubble letters, 3D tags or throw-ups, on a wall, a train or a clean background.

## What it does
Give the word or name, the lettering style and the surface. Claude tells you the price and paints your text as graffiti.

**How the files are made:** each graffiti piece is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install graffiti-generator@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Graffiti Generator talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/graffiti/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each graffiti piece uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The graffiti pieces show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_graffiti_models` | Models for graffiti pieces with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_graffiti_cost` | Exact price of one graffiti piece before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_graffiti` | Starts one graffiti piece in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_graffiti` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make graffiti of the name MAYA in bubble letters"
- "Paint DREAM BIG in wildstyle on a brick wall"
- "Create a neon 3D graffiti tag of my name, Leo"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the graffiti piece (the text, style, surface and colors) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
